sources.title: BLM Three Forks Recreation Site
sources.accessEvidence: BLM describes the site at the Owyhee / North Fork Owyhee / Middle Fork Owyhee confluence and lists a boat launch and vehicle parking.
sources.coordinateRole: recreation-site/access-area anchor, not surveyed ramp toe
sources.roadCaveat: BLM warns the final two miles are rocky and steep, may be impassable when wet, and recommends high-clearance four-wheel drive.

sources.title: BLM Three Forks Recreation Site Map
sources.interpretation: Confirms the site contains a ramp and related facilities; the reviewed map is not a coordinate publication for the ramp toe.

sources.title: USGS National Hydrography Dataset Flowline, Area, and Waterbody
sources.interpretation: The NHD offset identifies why this site marker entered the audit queue; it is not evidence that the launch is absent.
